About

Food & Beverage Intelligence
Through Data

With nearly 30 years of experience in the hospitality industry — including senior roles in city hotels, luxury resorts, and international chains — I have built a career grounded in operational leadership, financial strategy, and data-informed decision-making.

As a Food & Beverage Manager since 2010, I've overseen multimillion-euro budgets, designed daily workflow pipelines, led cross-functional teams, and implemented reporting systems that improved performance and accountability across departments.

Recognising the growing importance of analytics, I completed a one-year specialization in Data Analysis at the University of Athens. I've since built interactive dashboards and end-to-end BI solutions using Power BI and Microsoft Fabric, applying ETL, semantic modeling, DAX, relational databases and dimensional modeling — always grounded in real-world hospitality operations.

These portfolio projects reflect my ability to translate complex operational data into actionable insights — from focused Power BI dashboards to end-to-end Microsoft Fabric solutions — combining technical proficiency with deep hospitality business knowledge.

Featured Case Study Microsoft Fabric Hospitality BI

01 —

XHotel Food & Beverage Analytics

An end-to-end hospitality analytics solution designed around real Food & Beverage management questions — combining Microsoft Fabric data engineering, a governed semantic model and a multi-page Power BI management experience.

Executive revenue & department performance
Board, supplement & tax analysis
Warehouse, purchasing & inventory movement
Product mix, quantity, price & sales ranking
Direct Lake semantic-model reporting
Application-style Home navigation

Solution Architecture

A Fabric-first workflow that separates data preparation, storage, semantic modeling and report authoring into a reusable BI architecture.

Source Data→ Dataflow Gen2 / Pipelines→ Fabric Lakehouse→ Direct Lake Semantic Model→ PBIP / PBIR Report→ Power BI Service

Business Focus

Built for hotel F&B management: income, department contribution, supplements, board mix, warehouse flow, closing stock, product revenue and operational drill-down.

Semantic & Analytical Layer

Dimensional modeling, reusable DAX measures, month-over-month logic, share and ranking measures, chronological month sorting and controlled report-level season filtering.

Agentic Authoring Workflow

PBIP/PBIR development supported through VS Code, the Power BI Modeling MCP Server, Skills for Fabric and report-authoring validation tooling — with the semantic model used as the source of truth.

Dashboard Gallery

Six coordinated report experiences, designed as one management application rather than isolated dashboard pages.

Executive OverviewKey F&B performance at a glance
Revenue & Department AnalysisIncome trends, contribution and department performance
Supplement & Board AnalysisBoard, supplement and tax performance
Warehouse & Inventory AnalysisPurchasing, stock movement and warehouse activity
Product & Sales AnalysisProduct mix, quantity, pricing and sales performance
Home NavigationImage-led navigation across the analytical experience

Projects 02–04 · Deployment Framework

Hospitality BI Deployment Framework for the Existing Power BI Projects

The following framework applies specifically to Projects 02–04 — Hotel POS Executive Dashboard, End of Season F&B Analysis and Bookings Intelligence. It documents the established deployment methodology used for these Power BI solutions, from reusable templates and SQL architecture through gateway configuration, Power BI Service publishing and final reconciliation. Project 01 — XHotel Food & Beverage Analytics — uses the separate Microsoft Fabric architecture and PBIP/PBIR workflow described in its featured case study above.

01

Reusable Template

Every project is built on a reusable .PBIT template — enabling rapid deployment across properties without rebuilding from scratch.

02

SQL Architecture

A robust SQL-based architecture underpins all data pipelines, ensuring scalability, security and consistent query performance.

03

Dynamic Date Dimension

Dynamic Dim_Date generated via Power Query — always current, requiring zero manual updates as the calendar rolls forward.

04

Dimensional Model

A correct dimensional model (star schema) ensuring relationships are clean, DAX measures are reliable and reports are fast.

05

Refresh-Proof Setup

Reports are built to be refresh-proof — parameterised connections and error-handling Power Query steps that survive data changes.

06

Gateway & Scheduled Refresh

On-premises Gateway configuration with scheduled refresh — dashboards update automatically, no manual intervention required.

07

Publish to Service

Reports are published to Power BI Service within a managed Workspace — accessible to the right stakeholders, anywhere, any device.

08

SQL Reconciliation

Reconciliation against SQL source data at every stage — guaranteeing that what the dashboard shows matches what the database holds.

09

Production Simulation

Full production simulation before go-live — stress-testing refresh cycles, user access, and report performance under real conditions.
